Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 656 PM EST Tue Nov 10 2026

- Low chance for patchy fog overnight. 

- Increasing rain chances through tomorrow. 

- A much colder airmass arrives Thursday, triggering lake effect 
rain and snow showers late Thursday through Saturday.

&&

.AVIATION...

Clear skies to start the TAF period in a dry post frontal airmass. 
Winds are out of the W-NW this evening and earlier day gusts have 
come to an end. High pressure will lead to light to variable winds 
tonight. Not anticipating any fog tonight given the dry resident 
airmass and the increasing coverage of high clouds through tonight 
will limit radiative cooling. Winds become northeasterly tomorrow 
with OVC skies prevailing and an eventual reduction in ceiling 
heights late tomorrow afternoon into the evening.
